**Round 64 verdict: PASS, with `browserVerified: true`.** I did not edit any app code and made no commits.

**About this attempt:** the first attempt had already finished verifying and written all three reports. It then stopped on a network error before returning. On resume I checked that nothing had changed since: HEAD is still `038ed5a`, `git status` matches the end-of-run record, `ArrangementLane.tsx` has the same hash (`9105781c`), and the store (5173) and backend (5199) both return 200. So I did not re-run the tests. I added a resume note to the report, the checkpoint and the JSON, and checked that the JSON still has all its required fields with LF line endings.

**What was verified, re-run by me rather than taken from A's report:**
- **Code and gates:**
  - `npm run verify` returned 0: typecheck, 1583 tests in 89 files, and build.
  - With A's code change removed, exactly the 4 new tests that should fail did fail.
  - 11 deliberate code mutations were all caught by the tests.
  - The rest of the tree is unchanged.
- **Real browser, 1440×900 and 1280×720:**
  - A library sound dropped onto a lane now snaps to the edges of other clips, as well as the grid.
  - Holding Alt turns snapping on when it is off, and bypasses it when it is on.
  - Drops onto occupied space or the video lane are refused.
  - The group-move rows carried over from round 63 also passed.
  - This closes C-R62-01 and the Alt group-move gap.
- **Real audio and export:**
  - Edge-snapped clips start sounding within about 40 ms of their position, against the planned start.
  - An exported WAV starts exactly on the snapped edge (6.300 s, 0 ms error) and its length is correct to one frame. A muted clip was correctly left out.
- **Premium protection:** a new session with no credentials opens the demo page. The purchased Studio page asks for sign-in. The Studio token endpoint returns 401 with no token and 403 with a fake token. No protected requests were made from the demo.

**One new bug for B, C-R64-01 (Low):** for the first 2–4 seconds after the page loads, library sounds are still loading and cannot be dragged at all. The "not loaded yet" message the task expected is never shown in a real browser; only the jsdom unit tests can reach it. Nothing is lost. B needs to choose: accept this and fix the spec and tests, or let loading items be dragged so the message appears.

**Not run this round (out of scope):**
- video sync (C-R27-01);
- the full find → add → fit video → export flow;
- the FB-01..FB-16 regression;
- the end-to-end smoke test;
- the Tech Lead's manual check.

The open findings from `root-pre-push-review.md` and `publication-checkpoint.json` are carried into §9 of the report.

**Deviation from the task:** drags, held Alt and playback ran in standalone Playwright with real mouse input, not gstack. Each such row is labelled that way in the report. Only the sign-in and network checks used gstack.

On commit readiness: rounds 64 and 63 are ready for root to publish.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-64.md
- c-round-64.json
- c-round-64/checkpoint.md
